bead.title: claude-tui/gate: compute deltas, record verdict, dispose ADR-013
bead.description:
PROBLEM: With raw /usage snapshots captured for both modes, deltas must be computed, a verdict rendered against the pre-registered decision rule, and ADR-013 disposed (accepted / amended-negative / follow-up filed). Without this step the experiment yields no actionable outcome.

ROOT CAUSE: docs/helix/02-design/billing-observation-claude-tui.md contains 12 snapshots + 6 turn outputs but no computed deltas, no verdict, and no cross-reference to ADR-013. ADR-013 at docs/helix/01-frame/adrs/ADR-013-*.md remains in 're-proposed' status.

PROPOSED FIX: For each mode, compute subscription_window_delta = (after - before) for the subscription window field across all 3 runs (report individual + average) and api_request_count_delta = (after - before) for API metering. Write these into a 'Deltas' subsection of the doc. Apply the decision rule from the methodology section to render exactly one verdict: subscription-confirmed | subscription-rejected | subscription-ambiguous. Then take the verdict-conditional action:
- subscription-confirmed: flip ADR-013 status field from 're-proposed' to 'accepted' in the same PR; add cross-reference from ADR-013 to billing-observation-claude-tui.md and vice versa.
- subscription-rejected: amend ADR-013 to record the negative finding; close parent bead fizeau-9b3b85df with a summary; mark sibling sub-beads cancelled.
- subscription-ambiguous: file a follow-up experiment bead with a refined methodology; close this bead with notes referencing the follow-up id.

NON-SCOPE: Re-running measurements, modifying methodology, capturing additional /usage snapshots.

AC:
1) TestDeltasComputedPerMode: doc has subscription_window_delta and api_request_count_delta per run (3 each) plus average for both --print and PTY+hooks.
2) TestVerdictRecorded: doc contains exactly one verdict from {subscription-confirmed, subscription-rejected, subscription-ambiguous} with reasoning tied to the pre-registered decision rule.
3) TestADRDispositionConfirmed: if verdict == subscription-confirmed, ADR-013 status is 'accepted' and bidirectional cross-reference exists.
4) TestADRDispositionRejected: if verdict == subscription-rejected, ADR-013 has a 'Negative finding' amendment, parent fizeau-9b3b85df is closed with summary, and sibling sub-beads are marked cancelled.
5) TestAmbiguousDisposition: if verdict == subscription-ambiguous, a follow-up bead id is recorded in the doc and this bead is closed with notes.
6) TestExactlyOneDispositionPath: precisely one of AC#3/4/5 conditions is satisfied (matching the recorded verdict).

GATES: `go test ./...` passes; `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
bead.acceptance:
1) TestDeltasComputedPerMode
2) TestVerdictRecorded
3) TestADRDispositionConfirmed
4) TestADRDispositionRejected
5) TestAmbiguousDisposition
6) TestExactlyOneDispositionPath
Gates: `go test ./...`, `lefthook run pre-commit`.
